definitions.explanation: Not formal or serious; relaxed in manner.
Used to encourage someone to do something without formality or worry.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}でも{気軽|きがる}に{相談|そうだん}してください。
examples.english: Please feel free to consult me about anything.

examples.japanese: {気軽|きがる}な{服装|ふくそう}でお{越|こ}しください。
{気軽|きがる}に{話|はな}せる{友人|ゆうじん}がほしい。
examples.english: I want a friend I can talk to casually.

notes:
FORMS:
・{気軽|きがる}な + noun (adnominal)
・{気軽|きがる}に (adverbial) - "feel free to"
・{気軽|きがる}だ (predicative)

FORMATION:
{気|き} (spirit, feeling) + {軽|かる}い (light)

USAGE:
Often used to encourage others to do something without hesitation:
・{気軽|きがる}にどうぞ (feel free)
・{気軽|きがる}に{声|こえ}をかけてください (please don't hesitate to speak to me)
・{気軽|きがる}に{参加|さんか}できる (easy to participate in)

ANTONYM:
・{堅苦|かたくる}しい - stiff, formal
